cards.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is a man who likely attends numerous meetings, and today one more was added to his busy schedule. The U.S. Congress wants to have a closed-door chat with Huang over mounting concerns about national security. The congressmen bidding for his time say last week's report spurred the move that he may be the target of espionage by a reported Chinese asset: Megaspeed exec Alice Huang (family unrelated). In the House's letter on the matter, the lawmakers say the aforementioned reports "raise significant national security concerns" about China gaining access to U.S. technology and information. The previously reported claim is that Alice Huang is a Chinese plant in Singaporean data center outfit Megaspeed, siphoning information to Beijing. The Wall Street Journal (WSJ) further claims that she was recruited by Chinese authorities due to her existing relationship with Jensen Huang. Megaspeed reportedly bought and continues to buy billions' worth of Nvidia's chips, according to The New York Times (NYT), and stands accused by the Department of Commerce since 2024 of smuggling $2 billion worth of advanced silicon to China. The backdrop for the situation is that the U.S. has long-standing export controls blocking Nvidia and AMD's most advanced AI accelerator chips from reaching China, among a number of other nations. The allegations were first published last week in the NYT, and are reportedly sourced from unnamed U.S. intelligence officials. The House says the purpose of the briefing with Jensen Huang is to discuss "Nvidia's security protocols against foreign adversary espionage and [his] interactions with [...] Alice Huang." According to the NYT, the CEO never got a "defensive briefing," essentially a warning for potential targets of foreign espionage, to acquaint them with signs of such activities. The publication notes that intelligence officials often hesitate to inform potential targets of espionage, as doing so may make the spy aware they're being investigated. The NYT adds that President Trump was briefed on the situation surrounding Megaspeed and Alice Huang a year ago, but chose not to act on it. According to the WSJ, Singaporean authorities opened their own probe into Megaspeed, and even reportedly questioned Alice Huang directly. cards.body: Concerns are being raised that neither the Commerce Department nor Nvidia are doing their due diligence when it comes to vetting Chinese firms cleared to handle the company's H200 AI chips. According to The New York Times , New Matrix is on the list of approved firms, yet its offices are empty, "a hollow gray shell with wires dangling from the ceiling where lights should be." In fact, the paper could find little evidence that the company exists in any meaningful way: Only scant information can be found online about New Matrix, which was created 17 months ago. summary_data.subject_angle: **NVIDIA는 GR00T 파운데이션 모델을 범용 베이스로 두고 특정 하드웨어(Unitree G1)·태스크에 특화된 파인튜닝 모델과 시뮬레이션 벤치마크(G1-Factory)를 함께 패키징**해 Isaac Lab Arena 기반 개발 생태계를 강화하고 있다.
summary_data.focus_angle: **Unitree G1 같은 휴머노이드 OEM이 제조·물류 작업에 바로 적용 가능한 레퍼런스 정책을 확보**하게 되며, NVIDIA의 시뮬레이션-투-실제(sim-to-real) 파이프라인이 휴머노이드 로봇 상용화 속도를 높이는 촉매로 작용할 수 있다.

README:  # G1-Factory-GR00T-1.7: GR00T N1.7 for the Unitree G1 humanoid ## Model Overview ### Description: G1-Factory-GR00T-1.7 is a GR00T N1.7 vision-language-action policy fine-tuned for a Unitree G1 humanoid on the nine G1 Factory simulation tasks. From a head-camera image, the robot's upper-body joint state and a language instruction, it predicts chunks of whole-body actions. It was fine-tuned on the [G1-Factory-Benchmark](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/G1-Factory-Benchmark) demonstrations and runs in the [G1 Factory](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/G1-Factory) simulation scenes. It can also be used as a base policy for reinforcement-learning post-training. This model is ready for commercial or non-commercial use. **Developer:** NVIDIA. ### License/Terms of Use: [NVIDIA Open Model License](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/agreements/enterprise-software/nvidia-open-model-license/). ### Deployment Geography: Global. ### Use Case: Robotics researchers and developers use this policy to perform and evaluate the nine G1 Factory tasks in simulation. It also serves as a reference baseline and as a starting point for further fine-tuning or reinforcement-learning post-training. ### Release Date: Hugging Face 10/19/2026 via [G1-Factory-GR00T-1.7](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/G1-Factory-GR00T-1.7). ## References(s): - [G1-Factory-GR00T-1.7 on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/G1-Factory-GR00T-1.7) - [nvidia/G1-Factory-Benchmark](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/G1

key_facts: **DSRL(diffusion steering with reinforcement learning)**은 GR00T의 가우시안 노이즈 샘플링 단계에 작은 액터를 학습시켜 기존 정책 가중치를 바꾸지 않고 행동을 조정한다
베이스 모델은 nvidia/G1-Factory-GR00T-1.7이며 Unitree G1 휴머노이드가 콘솔까지 걸어가 빨간 버튼을 누르는 PushButton 작업에서 성공률을 높인다
RL Post-Training(RLPT) 워크플로우의 post-trained reference policy로 제공됨
**NVIDIA Open Model License**로 상업적·비상업적 사용 모두 허용, 배포 지역은 Global

summary_data.why_matters: 이 모델은 **시뮬레이션 상에서 VLA(vision-language-action) 정책을 강화학습으로 후처리하여 성능을 끌어올리는 재현 가능한 파이프라인**을 연구자들에게 제공한다. 휴머노이드 로봇 분야에서 기초 정책(GR00T)과 RL 후처리(RLPT/DSRL)를 분리하는 접근은 산업 현장 작업 적용 가능성을 높이는 실용적 벤치마크로 기능할 수 있다.
summary_data.subject_angle: NVIDIA는 **GR00T 파운데이션 모델 생태계를 Isaac-RLPT, IsaacLab-Arena 등 시뮬레이션·RL 툴체인과 결합**해 휴머노이드 로봇 소프트웨어 스택 전반을 선점하려는 전략을 이어가고 있으며, Hugging Face를 통한 오픈 라이선스 배포로 연구 커뮤니티 참여를 확대하고 있다.
summary_data.focus_angle: Unitree G1과 같은 휴머노이드 플랫폼에 NVIDIA의 GR00T+RLPT 파이프라인이 적용되면서, **자율주행과 유사한 '시뮬레이션 학습→RL 후처리' 방식이 휴머노이드 로봇 OEM들에게도 재사용 가능한 표준 워크플로우로 확산될 가능성**이 있으며, 이는 로봇 제조사들이 자체 모션 플래닝을 처음부터 구축하지 않고 NVIDIA 스택에 의존하게 되는 계기가 될 수 있다.

README:  # Isaac-RLPT GR00T N1.7 G1 Factory PushButton: DSRL steering policy ## Model Overview ### Description: Isaac-RLPT GR00T N1.7 G1 Factory PushButton DSRL is a steering policy, trained with reinforcement learning, that raises the success rate of the frozen GR00T N1.7 G1 policy ([G1-Factory-GR00T-1.7](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/G1-Factory-GR00T-1.7)) on the G1 Factory (IsaacLab-Arena) PushButton task, in which a Unitree G1 humanoid walks to a console and presses a red button. GR00T generates actions by denoising a Gaussian noise sample; DSRL (diffusion steering with reinforcement learning) trains a small actor that chooses that noise instead of sampling it, steering the frozen policy toward better actions without changing any of its weights. It is the post-trained reference policy of the RL Post-Training (RLPT) workflow. This model is ready for commercial or non-commercial use. **Developer:** NVIDIA. ### License/Terms of Use: [NVIDIA Open Model License](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/agreements/enterprise-software/nvidia-open-model-license/). ### Deployment Geography: Global. ### Use Case: Robotics researchers and developers use this policy to reproduce and study the improvement that reinforcement-learning post-training adds to a frozen vision-language-action policy in simulation, by comparing it with the paired baseline under the same evaluation. ### Release Date: Hugging Face 10/19/2026 via [Isaac-RLPT-GR00T-1.7-G1-Factory-PushButton-DSRL](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Isaac-

key_facts: 매디슨 황은 **8일 입국해 9~10일 코엑스 'NVIDIA AI Day Seoul 2026' 참석 및 정부 관계자 면담**을 할 예정이었음
입국 하루 전 일정이 갑자기 취소됐으며 구체적 사유는 공개되지 않고 '가족 사정'으로 알려짐
배경훈 부총리 겸 과기부 장관과의 면담 및 국내 기업과의 협력 논의 자리도 함께 취소됨
'NVIDIA AI Day Seoul 2026' 행사 자체는 예정대로 진행
매디슨 황은 올해 4월·6월·8월 방한해 **삼성전자, SK하이닉스, LG전자, 현대차, 두산로보틱스**와 피지컬 AI·로보틱스 협력을 논의한 바 있으며, 이번이 네 번째 방한이 될 예정이었음
summary_data.why_matters: 매디슨 황은 NVIDIA의 **피지컬 AI·로보틱스 사업에서 한국 주요 기업들과의 협력을 주도하는 핵심 인물**로, 그간 삼성전자·현대차·두산로보틱스 등과 연쇄 협력 논의를 이어왔다. 이번 방한 취소로 정부·기업과의 추가 협력 논의가 지연될 가능성이 있어 NVIDIA-한국 간 피지컬 AI 협력 모멘텀에 단기적 공백이 생길 수 있다.
summary_data.subject_angle: NVIDIA는 **옴니버스·로보틱스 플랫폼을 매개로 한국 제조·자동차·로보틱스 기업과의 생태계 확장을 핵심 인사가 직접 챙기는 전략**을 취해왔으며, 이번 일정 취소는 그 인적 네트워크에 의존한 협력 추진 방식의 리스크를 보여준다.
summary_data.focus_angle: 현대차와 두산로보틱스는 매디슨 황을 통해 NVIDIA의 피지컬 AI·로보틱스 플랫폼과 자율주행·휴머노이드 협력을 논의해온 만큼, 이번 방한 취소로 **관련 OEM·로봇 기업과의 기술 협력 논의 일정이 지연될 가능성**이 있으며 향후 재추진 시점이 주요 관찰 포인트다.

cards.body: 엔비디아 옴니버스·로보틱스 제품 마케팅 수석이사인 매디슨 황(젠슨 황 CEO의 장녀)의 한국 방문 일정이 전면 취소되면서, 당초 예정됐던 국내 일정도 줄줄이 무산됐다. 8일 업계에 따르면 매디슨 황은 8일 입국해 9~10일 서울 코엑스에서 열리는 '엔비디아 AI 데이 서울 2026'에 참석하고, 과학기술정보통신부 등 정부 관계자와의 면담을 가질 예정이었다. 그러나 입국을 하루 앞두고 일정이 갑자기 취소됐다. 구체적인 사유는 공개되지 않았으며, 업계에서는 가족 사정으로 알려지고 있다. 매디슨 황의 불참으로 배경훈 부총리 겸 과기부 장관과의 면담도 함께 취소됐다. 국내 기업과의 협력 논의 자리도 영향을 받은 것으로 전해졌다. 다만 '엔비디아 AI 데이 서울 2026' 자체는 예정대로 진행될 예정이다. 매디슨 황은 올해 4월·6월·8월에도 방한해 삼성전자, SK하이닉스, LG전자, 현대차, 두산로보틱스 등과 피지컬 AI·로보틱스 분야 협력을 논의한 바 있다. 이번 방문이 네 번째가 될 예정이었으나, 최종적으로 불참하게 됐다. 한편 같은 날 파이낸셜타임스(FT) 등 외신은 미 정보당국이 젠슨 황 CEO와 싱가포르 데이터센터 기업 메가스피드 임원인 앨리스 황이 연인 관계였다고 판단하고, 앨리스 황이 중국 국가안전부에 채용된 스파이일 가능성이 있다고 보도했다. 일부 업계에서는 이 보도와 방한 취소의 연관성을 거론하고 있으나, 직접적 연관성은 확인되지 않았다. 엔비디아 측은 관련 논평을 거부한 것으로 알려졌다. 이형두 기자 dudu@etnews.com - 이형두 기자기사 더보기 - ET Events

action.action: Jensen Huang이 중국 스파이로 의심되는 Alice Huang(Huang Le)과 로맨틱 관계였다고 판단, Financial Times가 이를 보도

key_facts: Financial Times 보도에 따르면 Alice Huang(Huang Le)은 Singapore 소재 **Megaspeed** 고위 임원이며 Jensen Huang과 로맨틱 관계로 보도됨
**Megaspeed는 자회사 Speedmatrix를 통해 약 $2 billion 규모의 AI 칩을 중국으로 밀수했다는 의혹**을 받고 있으며, NVIDIA는 Megaspeed와 중국 간 연관성을 부인
Megaspeed는 2023년 설립, Huang Le Limited 소유였다가 같은 해 Swiftdata에 매각, 2024년 Speedmatrix 통해 Malaysia Johor에 사무소 설립
Alice Huang은 Jensen Huang, Gigabyte 및 NetThunder 임원들과 함께 한 LinkedIn 게시물, 이후 Taiwan 레스토랑에서 Jensen Huang 뒤에 서 있는 모습이 포착됨
NVIDIA는 Jensen Huang이 연간 수천 명의 고객 임원과 만나며 일반적 비즈니스 정보만 교환했다고 반박, 중국 정부는 이를 '근거 없는 비방'이라고 주장
summary_data.why_matters: 본 의혹이 사실로 확인될 경우 **NVIDIA의 수출통제 준수 체계와 고객 심사(KYC) 프로세스에 대한 신뢰성**이 심각하게 훼손되며, 미중 기술 패권 경쟁 속 AI 칩 밀수·우회 공급망 문제가 정치적 쟁점으로 비화할 수 있다. 또한 CEO 개인 스캔들이 회사 평판 및 대중국 정책 결정에 영향을 미칠 가능성이 있다.
summary_data.subject_angle: **NVIDIA는 Jensen Huang 개인 리스크가 회사의 대중국 수출통제 준수 이미지와 직결**되는 상황에 처했으며, Megaspeed와 같은 소규모 신생 고객의 대량 주문이 어떻게 승인되었는지에 대한 내부 고객 심사 절차 투명성 요구가 커질 수 있다.

cards.body: Nvidia chief Jensen Huang is the center of a new controversy as the U.S. intelligence community believes that he had a romantic relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. According to the Financial Times , Alice Huang, sometimes referred to as Huang Le, was a top executive at Singaporean firm Megaspeed and was reportedly romantically involved with the CEO of the world's largest AI chip manufacturer. Notably, Jensen is currently married to his wife of 41 years, Lori Huang. It’s unclear whether Alice Huang was recruited by the Chinese Ministry of State Security (MSS) before she joined Megaspeed or after she had already established a business relationship with Jensen, but it’s been reported that the suspected agent was apparently targeting the Nvidia head to help Chinese companies gain access to banned AI chips. Go deeper with TH Premium: AI shortages (Image credit: Nvidia) AI data centers are swallowing the world's memory and storage supply Demand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsible Chip scarcity assaults auto industry amid the worsening Nexperia and DRAM crisis The custom AI ASIC state of play Megaspeed has been accused of smuggling $2 billion worth of AI chips into China via its subsidiary Speedmatrix, although Nvidia insists the company has no ties to China. Megaspeed sits at the center of a web of companies linked to China, and it was previously connected to a Chinese gaming company called 7Road International. It was founded in 2023 and reportedly owned by Huang Le Limited, led by Ms. Huang Le, or Alice Huang, before it was sold to Swiftdata that same year. The following year, Megaspeed used Speedmatrix to incorporate, with the subsidiary having two offices in Johor, Malaysia. The subsidiary is at the center of the smuggling allegations. Research into Huang Le, or Alice Huang, has revealed inconsistencies. There were reports that she started her career as a TV journalist working for Hunan TV and Chinese state broadcaster China Central Television (CCTV), but an executive at the former claims to have never heard of her, while she does not have a profile under the latter. After her supposed stint in media, she moved into banking and finance as assistant to the president of HSBC’s private banking division before becoming vice president at CITIC Securities, a Chinese financial services company. It’s unclear how she became involved with Megaspeed after that, but it seems Ms. Huang built a network of companies and investors around Shanghai and Zhejiang that aggressively pushed mobile gaming companies toward AI data centers. Questions arose about how a small company like Megaspeed could commit so much to buying Nvidia AI GPUs seemingly out of nowhere, but it certainly caught Jensen Huang's attention. After the company made its massive order, Alice Huang was spotted in a LinkedIn post hanging out for drinks with Jensen Huang and other industry executives from Gigabyte and NetThunder. summary_data.subject_angle: **Nvidia가 TSMC 등 핵심 파트너에게 3D DRAM 생산까지 요청**했다는 보도는 AI GPU 생산에 필수적인 메모리 공급 부족이 Nvidia 사업 확장의 실질적 제약 요인임을 시사하며, 메모리 공급망 다변화를 통한 리스크 관리가 Nvidia의 핵심 전략 과제로 부상했음을 보여준다.

related.title: TSMC denies exploring 3D DRAM at Nvidia's request — advanced memory tech is still years from market viability

cards.body: A recent report from The Information suggested that TSMC is exploring 3D DRAM production at Nvidia's request as surging demand for AI hardware strains global DRAM supplies and drives up prices. If the proposal were to come to fruition, it could mean a new, albeit prone to cyclical risks, business for TSMC and could dramatically expand its role in the AI supply chain. For its part, TSMC states that it is a pure-play logic foundry and plans to remain a logic foundry, which essentially means a denial of the report. Go deeper with TH Premium: Memory (Image credit: SK Hynix) AI data centers are swallowing the world's memory and storage supply Samsung debuts three next-generation memory technologies for AI data centers The future of DRAM: From DDR5 to future ICs High-bandwidth memory roadmap Inside the history of DRAM price-fixing lawsuits "Please note that TSMC focuses on our core business at all times, which is dedicated IC foundry," a TSMC spokesperson told Tom's Hardware. "Our mission is to be the trusted technology and capacity provider of the global logic IC industry for years to come." Despite the denial, according to two people familiar with the initiative cited by The Information , TSMC has begun preparing plans for 3D DRAM manufacturing following a request from Nvidia, its largest customer. The initiative is reportedly overseen by Hsu Kuo-chin, TSMC’s vice president responsible for advanced packaging and former head of Micron’s Taiwanese operations. The effort comes amid widespread memory shortages that turned memory from a commodity into a strategic asset that could determine whether a company can ship its products to customers or not. Although TSMC works closely with DRAM producers as it packages memory into system-in-packages (SiPs) for its customers, the company lacks the expertise and production capacity to make DRAM, let alone 3D DRAM. Meanwhile, given that 3D DRAM is years away even for major memory makers, pursuing a 3D DRAM strategy cannot solve memory shortages for at least five years. Unlike conventional DRAM, which arranges memory cells in a single plane, 3D DRAM places multiple levels of memory cells vertically to increase capacity per wafer. All three leading DRAM makers — Micron, Samsung, and SK hynix — are working on their 3D DRAM projects. However, Micron's DRAM strategy includes at least four more planar DRAM process technologies before 3D DRAM becomes a reality . While TSMC has arguably the industry's best logic process technologies, DRAM production requires entirely different manufacturing processes, which TSMC would have to develop, should it pursue making memory for its customers. Meanwhile, producing 3D DRAM requires completely different fabrication techniques to construct multiple memory-cell layers while controlling defects and maintaining acceptable yields. README:  # nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B-24GB ## Description **NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB** is a vision-language model (VLM) designed to run everyday agentic tasks locally, using a native 2-bit quantization to fit in 24GB of memory and run alongside other applications. It optimizes intelligence and speed per GB. It aims to achieve the optimal balance between speed and intelligence, being faster than most popular dense models while smarter than most popular MoE models with a similar memory footprint. README:  # Video-to-Data GR00T N1.7 Fine-Tuned Tissue-Box Lift ## Model Overview ### Description: NVIDIA Video-to-Data GR00T N1.7 Fine-Tuned Tissue-Box Lift predicts absolute joint-position action sequences for a simulated Vega/Sharpa robot to lift a tissue box, hold it, and then place it back down, using camera images, current joint positions, and a language instruction. This simulation-only checkpoint demonstrates how V2D-generated data can be used to fine-tune a robot policy. It has not been tested on a physical robot. It is a supervised fine-tune of [NVIDIA GR00T-N1.7-3B](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/GR00T-N1.7-3B) on V2D-generated simulation demonstrations for tissue-box manipulation. It implements the 58-dimensional J0_N16 joint-action contract: current joint state, 16 predicted actions, and four executed actions per decision in the documented integration. NVIDIA Corporation developed and owns this task-specific GR00T N1.7 fine-tune. This model is ready for commercial or non-commercial use. **Developer:** NVIDIA. ### License/Terms of Use: [NVIDIA Open Model License](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/agreements/enterprise-software/nvidia-open-model-license/). ### Deployment Geography: Global. ### Use Case: This checkpoint is intended only for simulation, as an example of supervised GR00T N1.7 fine-tuning with V2D-generated tissue-box demonstrations.
